Comprehensive validation pipeline: docker, GPU passthrough, image build, and in-container GPU smoke test

recommendations.title: Add rollback guidance for failed smoke test after successful build
recommendations.problem: If step 3 build succeeds but step 4 smoke test fails (cuda_available: False), no guidance on whether to keep or remove the potentially-broken image
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes successful build implies working image; partial failure scenario not addressed
recommendations.fix: Add to step 4: 'If smoke test fails after successful build, the image may have CUDA wiring issues. Options: (1) remove image with docker image rm and investigate Dockerfile, or (2) keep for debugging with docker run -it kermt:latest bash. Do not declare environment ready.'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for repeated setup
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on whether running kermt-setup multiple times is safe or has side effects
recommendations.root_cause: Idempotency implied by ensure_image fast-path but not explicitly stated
recommendations.fix: Add to Hard rules: 'Idempotency: running kermt-setup multiple times is safe — ensure_image skips rebuild if image exists, and all checks are read-only. Safe to invoke after environment changes or when troubleshooting.'

recommendations.title: Consolidate troubleshooting guidance
recommendations.problem: Error guidance scattered across workflow steps; no consolidated troubleshooting section for common issues
recommendations.root_cause: Inline error handling sufficient but harder to reference when debugging
recommendations.fix: Add Troubleshooting section after Hard rules: 'Common issues: (1) check_docker fails → install docker, start daemon; (2) check_gpu fails → install nvidia-container-toolkit, verify nvidia-smi on host; (3) build fails → check Dockerfile syntax, disk space; (4) smoke test fails → CUDA wiring issue, check base image CUDA version compatibility.'
